summary: # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 11 ## Re-Torque Optimization In this video, you will learn about the optimization content related to the Re-Torque function. ### Smart Torque The Smart Torque tools will help you quickly draw a torque line based on the segment level set on each line. 1. **Select the Smart Torque Tool** In the 2D window, select the Smart Torque tool. The Smart Torque dialogue frame will be displayed, allowing you to adjust the number of segments. 2. **Creating a Smart Torque Line** After adjusting the number of segments, you can click and drag the mouse on the 2D panel to create a Smart Torque line. Click again to complete the creation of the Smart Torque line; this line will be divided according to the number of segments specified. 3. **Internal Line Appearance** When the area formed by the Torque line is closed, the internal line will appear. If you click on a Smart Torque line border that has been created, you can adjust its number of segments again. 4. **Adjusting Segments** You can add a number of segments, and if the 3D intelligence of the Smart Torque line is relevant, you can use the Numbers tool to make adjustments. Additionally, you can use the "Therefore" tool to reduce the number of segments. 5. **Creating a Top Face** After all areas are closed, click on the Create button in the Smart Torque dialogue box to create a top face based on the Smart Torque line. You can also create a Smart Torque line with the top face that has been created. 6. **Clearing Smart Torque Lines** To delete all the created Smart Torque lines, select the clear option in the Smart Torque dialogue box; however, this will not affect the top face that has been created. ### Internal Smart Torque Line The internal Smart Torque line will only appear in the Smart Torque area, forming a triangle or square shape. - **Creating Additional Smart Torque Lines** Click on the Create button to create additional Smart Torque lines as needed. ### Support Top Points When the top point is created on the outside of the board with the sewing line, you will see the support top point automatically generated on the other side of the sewing line. - **Inserting Support Top Points** These support top points will help you absorb and create the top structure corresponding to the top point on the other side of the sewing line. You can easily insert the support in one of the upper edges of the board, bringing the top point to the top of the board and inserting it in the center from the bottom. - **Inserting Support on the Side of the Board** You can also insert the support on the side of the board at the top. ### Adjusting Support As mentioned before, the support can usually be separate, so use this tool to adjust it accordingly. By following these steps, you can easily insert the support at the bottom of the board.
